description: Cell-level Strong's numbers. The corpus tags at the lexical level, so every form of εἰμί arrives as G1510; the index also has finer numbers (G2076 for the third singular present, G2258 for the imperfect) that belong on particular cells. Each rule names a root and the parse codes a cell must carry, or a single spelling, to take the number. Numbers listed as unplaced are real index entries whose word does not occur in this corpus, or whose split is by sense rather than by parse and so cannot be a rule.

unplaced.reason: sense split, not a parse cell
the index files the comparative περισσότερος under G4053 nearly everywhere and reserves G4055 for occurrences sharing their parse with G4053 ones; no parse or spelling separates them
sense split: ἀπέχει is the same third singular present indicative at Matthew 15:8, Mark 7:6 and Mark 14:41, but only Mark 14:41 is the impersonal "it is enough" the index numbers G566

sense split: the genitive Ἰούδα is the territory at Matthew 2:6, Luke 1:39, Hebrews 7:14, Hebrews 8:8 and Revelation 5:5, 7:5, and a person at Mark 6:3, Luke 3:26, 3:30, 3:33, John 13:2, Acts 1:16 and 9:11, on one parse
sense split: the feminine accusative μακράν is the adverb "afar off" at Acts 2:39 but an ordinary adjective in "a far country" at Luke 15:13 and 19:12
the corpus files the adverbial εὐθύς under the adjective εὐθύς, whose own number this already is, so no rule is needed
